rawResults.Title: Connecting SQL Server to MCP using Data API Builder (DAB)
rawResults.Snippet: Mar 24, 2026Modern applications — especially AI-powered tools — need a secure and structured way to access databases. Using Microsoft Data API Builder (DAB) with MCP (Model Context Protocol) provides a powerful way to expose SQL Server data as APIs that AI agents and tools can safely consume.

rawResults.Title: SQL MCP Server: From Setup to Live Data - sqlfingers.com
rawResults.Snippet: Mar 24, 2026SQL MCP Server ships as part of Data API Builder (DAB), Microsoft's open source engine for exposing SQL Server data as REST, GraphQL, and MCP endpoints. Version 1.7 is what added MCP support. Install it at commmand line as a global .NET tool: dotnet tool install -g Microsoft.DataApiBuilder You'll see some first-run .NET output, then confirmation.
